<h2>Extract Variance Fractions from a Single sjSDM Object</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Extracts specified variance partitioning fractions from a
single sjSDManova object, returning a two-column tibble with
fraction labels and their Nagelkerke R² values.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>extract_jsdm_variance_fractions(
  anova_object,
  vec_anova_fractions = base::c("F_A", "F_B", "F_S", "F_AB", "F_AS", "F_BS", "F_ABS"),
  clamp_negative = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="anova_object">anova_object</code></td>
<td>
<p>A single sjSDManova-like list containing a named
'&quot;results&quot;' element with columns 'models' and
'&quot;R2 Nagelkerke&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_anova_fractions">vec_anova_fractions</code></td>
<td>
<p>A non-empty character vector of fraction codes to retain
(e.g. 'c(&quot;F_A&quot;, &quot;F_B&quot;, &quot;F_S&quot;)').</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="clamp_negative">clamp_negative</code></td>
<td>
<p>A single logical (default 'TRUE'). If 'TRUE', negative
Nagelkerke R² values are clamped to 0.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Accesses the named '&quot;results&quot;' element with 'purrr::chuck()',
filters the requested fraction codes, and translates them to
human-readable component labels.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble with columns:
</p>

<dl>
<dt>component</dt><dd><p>Character. Human-readable component label
(e.g. &quot;Abiotic&quot;, &quot;Associations&quot;, &quot;Spatial&quot;).</p>
</dd>
<dt>R2_Nagelkerke</dt><dd><p>Numeric. Nagelkerke R² value for
each fraction, optionally clamped to [0, Inf).</p>
</dd>
</dl>



<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[aggregate_jsdm_variance_components()]
</p>
